state.background: The approved Phase 6 follow-up retires the remaining mobile Playwright E2E case p45-b-tooltip-dismiss-231. Existing Browser Mode case p45-b-tooltip-dismiss-231-case01 exercises the production route with hit-tested mobile touch, checks the tooltip-open state, and verifies tooltip/cursor dismissal after scroll. The implementation removes only that runnable case and its stale mobile-pixel matcher, retains the shell spec and already-absent unknown-provenance bodies, and removes the empty Playwright stage from test:full while preserving the standalone test:e2e command. Four project records and a focused retirement plan document the superseding decision; historical 33-case ledger values remain unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: The mobile #231 Playwright test body and only its stale tooltip-dismiss project matcher are removed; the existing Browser Mode owner remains unchanged.
The retained tooltip-dismiss spec contains no runnable Playwright tests, and test:full does not invoke an empty Playwright suite while the standalone test:e2e command remains available.
Unknown-provenance test-body removals and historical Phase 5/6 migration counts are preserved and described accurately.
Production build, lint, the focused Browser Mode replacement, and the aggregate Browser Mode production-route suites pass; validation limitations are reported accurately.
verification: JEV plan revalidation returned valid_as_defined; result: results/plan45/phase6/jev-tooltip-231-e2e-retirement-plan-revalidation-result.json.
pnpm run build passed, including the production build TypeScript stage.

knownConstraints: The retired Playwright project had a Pixel 7 profile. Browser Mode uses a 412x915 viewport with mobile touch enabled and does not assert Pixel 7 user agent or device scale factor; no separate Pixel 7-only requirement was recorded.
Some other test-body deletions in the existing worktree have unknown provenance. They were preserved and not restored or reattributed.
The original migration ledger remains A=123, E=123, M=123 and 33/33; historical suite counts in earlier records are snapshots from before this retirement.
